en: Black‑and‑white street view of a European town, showing late‑19th/early‑20th‑century multi‑storey masonry buildings with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. The corner building on the left has a small tower with a spire and clock‑like feature, and ground‑floor shopfronts with large windows. Painted signage on the façades advertises shops selling colonial goods, delicacies, tobacco, and cigars. A few pedestrians and a bicycle stand near the entrances; there are no cars visible.
